title: Bosch Benchmark — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Bosch Benchmark.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Elevate Your Kitchen." Premium tier. Bosch Benchmark is the premium collection within the Bosch lineup — featuring FlexInduction cooktops, Speed Ovens, and pro-style handle design. It bridges the gap between standard Bosch and Thermador with better design and additional cooking features at a moderate premium.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Bosch loyalists wanting a step up without going to Thermador pricing. Kitchen designers who want Bosch reliability with premium aesthetics.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Bosch Benchmark:

• Same Bosch engineering with premium design and handles

• FlexInduction cooktops — most flexible induction cooking zones

• Speed Oven combines microwave and convection

• Bridges Bosch to Thermador — premium without the full luxury jump

• Home Connect WiFi standard
